name: write-prd
title: Write PRD
description: Compress the agreed design concept into a destination document the agent can execute against.
command_description: Turn the agreed design into a terse implementation-facing PRD.
prompt: Transform the current design concept into docs/ai/prd.md. Capture the problem, goal, non-goals, user stories, constraints, acceptance criteria, rollout, and testing expectations. Keep it implementation-facing rather than promotional. Use the same PRD contract for bug fixes and feature work.
